contact_index_convention: 0-based position in the (K5,K6) cross-contact list; identical to the cross_rows order of the frozen extractor

chain_space.note: the lower chain space of the real (K5,K6) window has 80 one-simplices; the 225 stated in the old prose is not reproduced by the frozen extractor. The 80 is the source-figure value reported by V3

metric.note: M = I + c L_G; M-I off-diagonals are -c W_ab (negative when W_ab>0)

local_response.quantity: h_a(t) = sum_k u_{a,k}^2 exp(-t lambda_k) over the (K5,K6) operator; delta = eta=1 (M_G) minus eta=0 (M=I)
local_response.expected_top: V3 expects the two largest changes at contact indices 10 and 9

quadratic_form.v_convention: v has non-zero entries only at a,b; total = (v_a^2+v_b^2) + c[d_a v_a^2 + d_b v_b^2 - 2 W_ab v_a v_b]; the cW_ab(v_a-v_b)^2 column is the pairing term, the diag/cross columns state the other terms explicitly
